name: qwencloud-vision
title: QwenCloud Vision
description: Understand images and video with Qwen vision models - OCR, charts, grounding and visual Q&A.

steps.instruction: Pre-check the media: format and size; downscale anything over 4MB before upload.
Use the qwen-mm tools: ocr/read_image for text extraction, vision_chat for charts with an explicit 'read the axes first' instruction.
Route to a vision model: qwen3-vl-plus primary, qwen3-vl-32b via OpenRouter as fallback, local qwen3-vl-8b offline.
Grounding and bbox tasks: ask for normalised coordinates and check they sit in [0,1] before drawing.
Multiple images: at most 4 per request, and describe their order so the model knows which is which.
Never let a vision answer invent content - cross-check any load-bearing numbers against the source.
